title: GLHEXEN II
subtitle: Raven Software, 1997 · 1.12 (the GPL mission-pack source), the Win32 OpenGL build
argsHint: -window keeps it in a window (gl_vidnt.c would otherwise ask for a fullscreen mode the page cannot give); -nomidi skips the music, which has no MIDI device to play on here.

needsData.hint: data1/ from the retail CD patched to 1.11 (pak0.pak, pak1.pak, progs.dat, progs2.dat, strings.txt), plus infolist.txt from the GPL source release

_why: Raven's Quake-derived engine, from its 2000 GPL release: Winquake.dsp's GL Release configuration on src/env/opengl32.c, the same WGL layer GLQuake's and Quake II's Win32 builds draw through.
_data: The 1.12 code refuses the 1997 demo's pak0 (its count and checksum say modified, and the demo is not registered), so it runs on the retail data: the CD's data1 patched by Raven's own H2_Patch_v111.exe, run under Wine.
